module: "Trailer Respawn Control" node (category `once_instant`, depends on `core_trailerRespawn`). Enables or disables automatic respawn of trailers along with their vehicles (`core_trailerRespawn.setEnabled(enabled)`). Pins: `enabled` (bool, default false, hardcoded), `flow` as input and output.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: If the input flow is active, calls `setEnabled` and propagates the flow.
